item: scripts/diff_installed_versions.py compares the Installed-versions blocks of two CI job logs (added, removed, changed pins and what moved in the environment line), so R349's "diff package versions first" is one command (R380 item 3)
summary: R349 said to diff the package versions of a green and a red job first, and R364 put the list at the tail of the test and Core-only logs; the comparison itself was still a by-eye pass over 87 to 109 lines. diff_installed_versions.py OLD NEW (each a log file or - for stdin; raw log with timestamps, step summary, or the get_job_logs JSON) finds the one block the step prints and reports changed, added, removed and unchanged packages by pip's name rule (PEP 503), and which of Python, runner image and kernel moved. Exit 0 identical, 1 different, 2 not comparable. It refuses to guess: no heading, a block cut off before its closing fence, no opening fence, an empty block, a block with no name==version line, two blocks in one log, and JSON without logs_content are each an error naming OLD or NEW and what was seen, never a comparison against an empty list (which would read as every package removed); a non-pin line and a duplicate name are reported, not dropped. MEASURED on the two real Core-only tails (job 122649746920 of run 40638055096 and job 122725010413 of run 40661391305): 87 packages each, 0 changed, 0 added, 0 removed, while the environment line differs in all three fields (python 3.13.17 -> 3.13.16, runner image ubuntu24 20261026.354.1 -> 20261023.334.3, kernel 7.0.0-1017-azure -> 6.17.0-1022-azure) and the LATER run was on the OLDER image, so the header line is half the answer. tests/test_diff_installed_versions.py (37 tests) includes a drift guard that runs the real Installed versions step of both jobs in ci.yml under bash with a stub python and reads its output with the script; seven mutants of the script and four of the step were each seen to fail a test. R379 correction riding this change: the wheel-layout lesson now carries the runner's measured figures (the step took 15 s on run 40661391305; the job 74 s against 50 s on run 40638055096) in place of the inferred ones; the 20.1 s build stays labelled as the sandbox figure. STATED LIMITS: it says which pins differ, not which caused a failure; it compares what pip list reports for the job given, only in the two jobs R364 names; a tail-limited reader must reach the heading.
